text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer-san! It is truly a 
splendid, refreshing morning.
choice_data_list: You're full of energy, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Thanks to you. I was able to refresh 
myself over the break. I had wonderful 
dreams too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It was a dream where I ate sweets until I 
was sooooo full...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... It truly was a sweet moment, just 
like a dream.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu♪ I feel like I can devote myself to 
training even more than usual!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Alright! To fulfill the cherished wish of 
the Mejiro family, let us give it our all 
today as well~!

It looks like Mejiro McQueen got plenty of 
rest, both mentally and physically.
